subject: Crescent security QA: post-call recap & onboarding questions
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Crescent security QA: post-call recap & next steps

Hi Liam — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can scope the right form (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom):

- High-level: Crescent wants to evaluate Redwood for production inference of patient-facing triage assistants. You mentioned PHI will be involved for some use cases.
- Immediate asks from our side: SOC 2 status, encryption at rest + in transit, KMS options, and whether you have a preferred evidence collection format.

To move forward we can (pick one):
1) Share our SIG prefill (attached) and ask Crescent to complete a short CAIQ subset, OR
2) Crescent can send your internal security form and we’ll fill it out, OR
3) We kick off a custom questionnaire where we prefill common answers and request a few evidence files.

Clarifying questions (so we route correctly):
- Will Crescent be sending or storing ePHI in Redwood-managed storage, or will you route/stage only non-identifiable tokens?
- Do you require EU/UK data residency for any subset of traffic (you indicated mostly US but wanted to confirm)?
- Any procurement or legal contacts we should loop in for DocuSign once we confirm controls?

Next steps I propose: I’ll share the SIG prefill now; if you prefer CAIQ we can send the link. Can you confirm which form you prefer and whether your security team expects evidence (SOC 2 report) up front or after an initial prefill?

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx (prefill template)

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
pri***@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crescentlabs.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: security@crescentlabs.com
Date: 2026-09-03T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crescent security QA: post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Priyom — good call. Quick answers: 

- SOC 2: Crescent completed SOC 2 Type II in June 2025; we can provide a redacted report.
- PHI: For the pilot, we will be sending limited PHI (patient initials + timestamps). We need to confirm how Redwood treats token-level storage and any optional zero-retention modes.
- Residency: All production data must live in US-East; no EU residency required for this project.
- Evidence: Our security team prefers a CAIQ or the SIG prefill + the redacted SOC 2 as evidence.

We attached a short internal overview (crescent-internal-security-overview.pdf). We can complete the SIG prefill if you send the sheet. One question on your side: do you support customer-managed keys (KMS) or bring-your-own-key? If not, what encryption guarantees exist?

We are targeting a security review window the week of 9/14; happy to have a quick sync with your security eng if needed.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security, Crescent Labs
liam.oconnor@crescentlabs.com | +1 (617) 555-8899

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crescent security QA: post-call recap & next steps

Looping in a couple clarifying internal items before we send the prefill: 

- KMS: Redwood supports both our managed KMS and customer-managed keys (via AWS KMS integrations). If Crescent needs BYOK we should capture key rotation and HSM requirements in the prefill.
- PHI handling modes: we have a zero-persistence mode (KV cache-only) for inference and an option to skip any logging; need to confirm whether Crescent's pilot requires persistent logs for debugging.
- Evidence cadence: given they already have SOC2 Type II, we can mark SOC2 as "available upon request" in the prefill and highlight encryption/KMS evidence up front.

Ask for the prefill: Priyom — can you add two short fields to the attached sheet before we send (1) 'pilot PHI persisted? yes/no' and (2) 'procurement contact for PO/DocuSign'? I will prepare a one-pager on our KMS options to attach.

Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crescentlabs.com>, security@crescentlabs.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crescent security QA: post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Liam — appreciate the quick answers and the overview. Attached is an updated prefill with the two extra fields Monica requested. A few concrete asks to keep momentum: 

1) Please complete the attached prefill and return by 9/10 so our security team can triage and surface any gap items.
2) Please attach the redacted SOC 2 (if available) and the dataflow diagram (we can accept a screenshot).
3) Confirm whether Crescent wants BYOK (customer-managed KMS) or Redwood-managed keys — if BYOK, include expected HSM/KMS provider in the prefill.

If you’d like, we can schedule a 30-minute sync between your security engineers and our security team the week of 9/14. I’ll also open a HubSpot task (linked) and route the DocuSign once controls are agreed.

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx, crescent-dataflow-diagram.png
Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DL-2026-0896

Best —
Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
